name: Variety
description: Industry reporting on casting, film releases, festivals, awards and television. Original reporting is preferred over syndicated copies.

name: Deadline
description: Film and television industry reporting. Casting announcements and production news qualify; speculative deal chatter does not.

name: The Hollywood Reporter
description: Entertainment reporting and professional interviews. A meeting, an expression of interest, or a rumor is not treated as a confirmed role.

name: Focus Features
description: First-party release information and production interviews. Studio publicity is labeled as such; commercial claims are attributed to the studio.

name: GQ
description: Direct, edited conversations about roles, performance and filmmaking. Lifestyle coverage and private-life material are excluded.

name: Rotten Tomatoes
description: Editorial interviews about films and performances. Promotional partnerships are disclosed where relevant; scores and fan chatter are not news.

name: ComicBook.com
description: Only individually reviewed, direct interviews about her work. Fan theories, speculation, rankings and routine fandom coverage do not qualify.

name: Seventeen
description: The archive includes a direct interview about 13 Reasons Why and Superman & Lois. This is approval of that article, not the publication's entire celebrity section.
